1 FIR duly following the procedure, as illegal, arbitrary, unjust, whimsical, violative of Articles 14, 21 and 19 of Constitution of India and contrary to the provisions of Criminal Procedure Code, and consequently merge the subsequent FIRs namely FIR No.87/2019, dated 02.06.2019 and FIR No.94/2019, dated 09.06.2019 along with first FIR 58 of 2019 for the purpose of one and same charges and trying together for the alleged same common offences duly cancelling the subsequent FIR.87/2019 and FIR.94/2019 and consequently direct the Respondents 2 and 3 herein not to register any fresh FIR in respect of the above alleged crimes of alleged illegal Kidney Transplantation Surgery, in the interests of justice and to pass IA NO: 1 OF 2019 Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the Respondents 2 and 3 herein not to register any new crime / FIR in respect of the crime in connection with FIR No.58/2019, dated 15.04.2019, on the file of the 3rd respondent herein, pending disposal of the above Writ Petition and pass IA NO: 2 OF 2019 Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the respondents 2 and 3 to club/merge the subsequent FIRs namely FIR No.87/2019, dated 02.06.2019 and FIR No.94/2019,
dated 09.06.2019 into first FIR No.58 of 2019 for the purpose of single set of charge and trial in the interests of justice pending disposal of the Writ petition in the interest of justice and pass Counsel for the Petitioner:
1. CHALASANI AJAY KUMAR Counsel for the Respondent(S):
1. GP FOR HOME (AP) THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE B.V.L.N.
CHAKRAVARTHI WRIT PETITION NO: 7458 of 2019 The Court made the following Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Government Pleader representing the State is in attendance.
2. Learned Additional Government Pleader on written instructions would submit that the Police completed investigation in Crime Nos.58 of 2019, 87 of 2019 and 94 of 2019 and laid charge sheets vide C.C.No.2049 of 2020, 3286 of 2020 and 3288 of 2020 all on the file of the learned II Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Visakhapatnam, respectively.
